gpt2-medium.temp_escape: +0.25 per stall/discard (cap 1.4, reset on clean segment)

segment_gates.stall: >=20 identical consecutive values -> run cut back

gpt2-medium.early_stop: generation halts when 6 identical values appear in decoded tail
